description: Java class implementing contact access using Android's current Contacts API, including methods to get contact pick intent and load contact details.

classes.name: ContactAccessorSdk5
classes.description: Android class for accessing contact information using the current Contacts API, extending ContactAccessor.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Returns an intent to pick a contact from the contacts list.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact information such as display name and phone number given a contact URI.
